text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono brilliantly conquers the 
race! A tremendous round of applause 
erupts for such a magnificent battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono looks out at the stands 
filled with smiles. Seeing a sight she had 
witnessed so many times hardened her 
resolve—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rushes out toward the underground paddock 
passage to look for the Trainer.
